company.name: Arctic Health
company.shortDescription: Arctic Health is a credentialing platform that provides AI-enabled credentialing and payer enrollment services for healthcare organizations.
company.description: Arctic Health provides credentialing and contracting services for healthcare organizations, including telehealth providers, clinics, group practices, RCM companies, and CVOs. The company manages provider credentialing and payer enrollment, handling documentation collection, CAQH profile management, application preparation, and submissions to commercial and government payers. Arctic Health supports payer enrollment and contracting tasks such as new practice setup, contract negotiation, rate optimization, multi-state licensure, appeals, and revalidation. Its platform offers automated onboarding, status tracking, and re-credentialing, with applications reviewed by credentialing specialists. For organizations operating at scale, Arctic Health provides API-based integration, custom workflows, AI-powered document extraction and error detection, and white-label credentialing under client brands.
